data.historical_tests: not new blind; excluded training and selection
data.test: 3 new geometry-only positions after checkpoint freeze; 12 configurations each; >45m from all M5A-E positions; weather change

sample: Same seeded group round-robin, half target-support cameras / half uniform six cameras. One camera perstep, all six evaluated. Cache frozen backbone RGBfeatures only.
loss: 0.5 positive BCE mean + 0.5 confirmed non-target BCE mean when both supported; ignore nevernegative; no pairloss. Equal setting for allmodels.
selection: Validation only. Each scene pixelprecision>=.8,recall>=.8,emptyFPR<=.01. Minimax normalized violation then highest macroIoU then earlierstep. All infeasible remainPartial. Thresholds .1 to .9. AP uses256fixedhistbins and is named histogramAP.
actor_detection: Geometrically associated renderidentity (not actorID), >=3validpixels eligible; >=3predicted and >=50% pixel recall detected. Pixel size <=32 small,33-128 medium,>128 large. Zero-support actors retained.
geometry: Four A/B/C/D interventions use identical rounded native S16 orP8 UV and reliablelabelmask; OriginalDepth and original48LID frozen. Scores accumulate foregroundmass,totalmass,raycount; no tiny-mass normalization. q=1-exp(-foregroundmass), eventscore not calibratedoccupancy. Threshold .1,.2,.4,.6,.8 chosen onlyval. Perstride nativegrid report; commonS16grid supplementary forS8/16 comparability.
fusion: Optional scalar logistic head on oldM5E evidence logit and foreground logmass, fit reliabletraining firstsurfaces only after factorization; compare trainbudgetmatched old-only recalibration; 100steps2seeds, fixedfrozenpixel. No test-driven decision.
stop: No extension beyond400steps/models/seeds. Nonfinite or leakage stops; labelquality first. Newtest once after schema/model/thresholdselection freeze. No defaultDepth/Splat/Runtime changes; no longruntimepressure. No formalM5pass frompixelresults.
reference: Renderedfirsthit self-consistency; not independentMesh or physicalfree. Buildings/walls negative only for imageforeground classification. Unknown evidence notFalsePositive without reference.
shadow: RecordedRGB offline only. No controlactions. Latency GPU isolated from CARLA tick experiments; originalruntimeunchanged.
